currentContract: OriginalWeaponRangeLine clips finite clip-space endpoints, transforms to window coordinates, then emits six vertices for two triangles spanning endpoint AABB plus extent=max(1,round(width))/2+2 (shader:437-458). Color is flat from vb; line endpoints/depth remain flat (shader:414-417,443-457).

Single-sample fragment quantizes endpoints to signed 8-bit subpixels, uses exact symbolic-epsilon diamond acceptance and major-axis wide-line replication, then writes interpolated line depth only for accepted fragments (shader:459-517,529-534,560-565). Alpha, mask, and stencil/depth pipeline semantics must remain unchanged (shader:519-565; setup:125-146,202-209,232).

MSAA uses distinct actual-sample rectangle coverage and depth at each sample (shader:579-596; NativeMultisampleLineShaders.h:9-31), so the single-sample diamond bound cannot be reused. Fill, mask, minimap composite use different vertices/fragments (shader:426-435,523-527,550-574; setup:125-139,179-195).

Line setup preserves captured scissor but expands raster viewport to full attachment; the source viewport and target output viewport can differ (setup:171-175,205-214). Preserve this and RANGE199 indices (setup:16-39,228-233), RANGE_DIVISION233 corrected integer division (shader:481-499), and OriginalRangeVertex/world-line math (shader:125-392).
proofRequirementsForAnyDistinctFutureCan: Restrict to validated finite, positive <=64 line width, single-sample LineLoop and explicitly demonstrated subtypes; preserve original fallback for degenerate/zero-quantized segments, nonfinite/large transformed coordinates, clip-edge or precision uncertainty, unsupported sample counts, fill/composite and unproved minimap/masked paths (NativeWeaponRangeData.cpp:100-125; shader:448-457; setup:167-180).

Prove every originally accepted pixel center and any needed 2x2 helper lanes lie inside candidate raster geometry after the exact same float32 clip, viewport conversion, signed 8-bit quantization, major-axis tie rule, triangle winding, and target projection. Verify both old/new accepted sets and no added accepted pixels outside the old AABB, including near endpoints, negative coordinates, width-rounding boundaries, scissor edges, and clipped line ends (shader:419-424,449-517).

Preserve flat provoking color, two-triangle seam/winding, original alpha/depth/stencil and mask read order, MSAA sample and alpha-to-coverage states; require GPU pixel/depth/stencil parity for any materially distinct geometry because rational coverage proof alone does not establish float32 rasterized containment (shader:414-417,519-596; setup:125-146,202-214). No line FS explicit derivatives are visible in this source, but a changed transport must still maintain required helper coverage and not rely on that observation as a global shader contract.
